notes: מִתְהַלֵּךְ carries no preposition of its own here, so the as of as a robber is read as the supplied word its adverbial function licenses (rule 33) rather than as an unrepresented preposition's; the parallel colon's written כְּ takes its own as.
מָגֵן is rendered attributively as armed under rule 28, the indefinite article going to אִישׁ.
